visual_action: A slideshow of two still photographs of a man. The first shows him smiling behind a birthday cake with the number '52' on it. The second shows him wearing a cowboy hat. Text overlays appear on both images.

cast.name: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo
cast.evidence: The on-screen text identifies him by name: "This is Lorenzo Salgado Araujo".

cast.name: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement
cast.evidence: The on-screen text names the organization: "On Tuesday, ICE shot and killed him".

on_screen_text.text: On Tuesday, ICE shot and killed him
He was a family man who worked hard to provide for his wife and sons, helping them afford college

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video.
audio_music: A slow, somber, and mournful instrumental track plays throughout, featuring what sounds like a cello. The music sets a tragic and sad tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow consisting of two static images.
central_claim: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) unjustly shot and killed Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, a hardworking family man.
intended_effect: To evoke sympathy for Lorenzo Salgado Araujo and his family, and to generate anger and outrage towards ICE.
